Zelador de Condomínio - Recreio dos Bandeirantes

Estamos em busca de um Zelador de Condomínio para se juntar à nossa equipe no Recreio dos Bandeirantes.

O candidato ideal será responsável por manter a limpeza, organização e segurança do condomínio, garantindo um ambiente agradável e confortável para moradores e visitantes.

Entre as principais responsabilidades, o Zelador deverá realizar limpeza geral, incluindo banheiros, áreas comuns e áreas de serviço.

Será responsável por manter a manutenção preventiva de equipamentos e instalações, como pintura, jardim e calçada.

Além disso, deverá estar atento a eventuais reparos e reportar quaisquer problemas para os responsáveis.

Experiência em manutenção predial e limpeza é um diferencial.

O candidato deverá ter boa comunicação, responsabilidade e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.

É importante que possua habilidades para resolver problemas de forma rápida e eficiente, além de ter um olhar atento para detalhes que contribuam para a manutenção do bem-estar do condomínio.

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho agradável e uma remuneração competitiva, além de benefícios adicionais conforme a legislação vigente.

Se você é organizado, tem responsabilidade e busca um ambiente de trabalho que valorize o seu empenho, esta é a oportunidade certa para você.

Junte-se à nossa equipe e contribua para criar um condomínio onde todos se sintam em casa

ASSISTENTE OPERACIONAL

RESPONSABILIDADES ATRIBUÍDAS: Prover informações pertinentes a problemas relacionados aos embarques. Abertura de processos operacionais no sistema operacional da empresa. Incluir informações em planilhas de controle interno e externo. Organizar os embarques de consolidadas periódicas nos modais marítimos e aéreos. title: Vendedor - Rio de Janeiro
description:
Nosso sucesso é fruto da dedicação e do talento das pessoas que trabalham conosco. Construímos uma cultura forte, baseada em valores sólidos, que guiam nossas decisões, estratégias e a busca por profissionais alinhados ao nosso propósito.

Acreditamos que desafios são oportunidades e buscamos talentos que compartilhem de nossos valores, contribuindo para um ambiente dinâmico e inspirador.

Juntos, seguimos aprimorando nossa cultura e fortalecendo nosso compromisso de alimentar sua vida.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Você será responsável por:

  • Construir e manter relacionamentos com clientes, especialmente com grandes e médias contas;
  • Entender e se manter atualizado sobre a indústria de lácteos, seus concorrentes diretos e tendências de mercado;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das metas de vendas (volume, margem e mix) com excelência no atendimento da sua área;
  • Visitar a matriz dos clientes da sua carteira e conduzir negociações estratégicas;
  • Desenvolver e executar o plano de negócios de vendas para atingir as metas;
  • Acompanhar resultados de vendas do canal, da Cia e das metas pessoais;
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e realizar projeções e cálculos de vendas (margem, markup);
  • Controlar nível de ruptura, devolução e retorno nos clientes, influenciando no pedido e parâmetros da loja.

Local de atuação: Rio de Janeiro

Requisitos e qualificações

O que a Vigor espera:

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Conhecimento intermediário no Pacote Office;
  • Experiência no ramo de Alimentos ou Bebidas;
  • CNH ativa e Carro Próprio;

Nossas pessoas transformam obstáculos em oportunidades e são desafiadas a darem o melhor de si em um ambiente dinâmico e cheio de desafios.

Buscamos pessoas que compartilhem dos nossos valores e acrescente com a nossa cultura. Ela traduz nosso jeito de ser e nos orienta diariamente, nas decisões, na busca de profissionais e na estratégia do negócio.

title: Consultor(a) Comercial Externo
description:
A Stone:


A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros, focada no(a) cliente e na transformação da indústria de pagamentos para apoiar o empreendedorismo brasileiro.
Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades.

Como será seu dia a dia: 

  • Atuará em rotina externa para prospectar novos clientes na rota do polo.
  • Gerenciar a carteira de clientes ativos e de pós-venda.
  • Participar das matinais diárias do time para traçar os seus planos, metas e trocas de aprendizados.
  • Entregar um atendimento de excelência ao nosso cliente.

Conheça um pouco mais a rotina do Agente Stone no nosso manifesto.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Desejável experiência prévia em vendas externas no setor de adquirência ou serviços financeiros.
  • Habilidade em negociação e abordagem comercial
  • Trabalhar de forma orientada a resultados e metas

Nossos Benefícios:


Plano de Saúde e Odontológico
Hospital Virtual Verde, disponível 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana, de forma rápida e prática
Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação - Pluxee

 Benefício Educação - Plataforma interna com acesso a diversos livros, podcasts, treinamentos e vídeo aulas visando o autodesenvolvimento (Studa e Biblioteca StoneCo)

Nossa Cultura: 


Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Espírito de dono traz liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo que entregamos e buscamos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
Live the Ride: Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com erros e vemos desafios como oportunidades de crescimento.
No Bullshit: Agimos com simplicidade. Somos práticos, sinceros e valorizamos feedbacks, usando transparência para evoluir, mesmo em erros.
Team Play: Quer ir rápido? Vá sozinho(a). Quer ir longe? Vá em equipe. Aprendemos uns com os outros, e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.
The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos impactá-lo positivamente e ver as melhorias que trazemos à sua vida.


E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerStone

title: Broker de Resseguros Sr
description:
Posting Description

Broker de Resseguros Sr.

Você prospera em um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, que demande uma atuação multidisciplinar? Possui experiência broker de resseguros, com vivência na integralização de contratos e controle de todo o fluxo contratual?  Se você respondeu "SIM", este pode ser o próximo passo em sua carreira como Broker de Resseguros Sr.

Esta é uma função par atuar presencialmente no escritório localizado em São Paulo/SP ou Rio de Janeiro/RJ.

Aon está no negócio de melhores decisões

Na Aon, moldamos decisões para melhor proteger e enriquecer a vida das pessoas no mundo todo.

Como organização, estamos unidos pela confiança como uma equipe inclusiva e diversificada, e somos apaixonados por ajudar nossos colegas e clientes a terem sucesso.

Como será o seu dia

Prospecção de negócios de resseguros e retrocessão;

Acompanhamento do fluxo contratual e renovação dos negócios da companhia;

Presença comercial com clientes e prospecções da companhia;

Trabalho analítico para desenvolvimento de soluções de resseguros para clientes e prospects;

Controle e produção de documentos de resseguro da Aon e aos clientes;

Acompanhamento de resultados e desenvolvimento de relatórios de apoio aos clientes..

Como esta oportunidade é diferente

Nesta posição você poderá trazer todo seu conhecimento para atuar prospectando novos negócios e apoiando clientes vigentes no desenvolvimento de soluções de resseguros, integralização de contratos e controle de todo o fluxo contratual relacionado ao portfólio da companhia.

Habilidades e experiência que levarão ao sucesso

Formação Acadêmica completa em Ciências Atuariais, Economia, Administração.

Vivência prévia como Broker de Resseguro.

Domínio avançado no Pacote Office.

Domínio avançado do inglês.

Domínio avançado em espanhol será considerado um diferencial.

Como apoiamos nossos colegas

Além do nosso pacote de benefícios abrangente, incentivamos uma equipa e atmosfera de trabalho inclusiva. Mais, o nosso ambiente ágil permite-lhe gerir o seu bem-estar e o equilíbrio entre o trabalho e a vida pessoal, garantindo que pode dar o seu melhor na Aon. Adicionalmente, todos os colegas desfrutam de dois "Dias Globais de Bem-Estar" por ano, incentivando-os a reservar tempo para se concentrarem em si próprios.  Oferecemos uma variedade de soluções de estilo de trabalho também para os nossos colegas.

A nossa cultura de aprendizagem contínua inspira-o e prepara-o para aprender, partilhar e crescer, ajudando-o a atingir o seu potencial máximo. Como resultado, na Aon está mais conectado, mais relevante e mais valorizado.

A Aon valoriza um local de trabalho inovador e inclusivo, onde todos os colegas se sintam capazes de serem autênticos. A Aon orgulha-se de ser um local de trabalho com oportunidades iguais para todos.

A Aon oferece oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os funcionários e candidatos a emprego, independentemente de raça, cor, religião, credo, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, origem nacional, idade, deficiência, veterano, estado civil, status de parceiro doméstico ou outro status legalmente protegido.

Aceitamos inscrições de todos e oferecemos aos indivíduos com deficiência ferramentas de acessibilidade para participarem de processos seletivos, como candidatura, entrevista e para desempenharem funções de trabalho essenciais, uma vez contratados. A Skidun é uma agência com 17 anos de história, referência em branding, posicionamento estratégico e construção de audiência. Atuamos com marcas como NBA, Sportv, Adidas, Vasco, Goodyear, UFC, Globoplay, Multiplan, entre outras.

Descrição do emprego

Estamos buscando um braço de conteúdo para a Skidun: Para acompanhar o time no dia a dia, transformar bastidores e projetos em narrativas relevantes, e garantir presença constante e coerente da marca nas redes.

Principais pilares de atuação:

1. Podcast:

  • Organizar a agenda de gravações e convidados.
  • Acompanhar as gravações presenciais (com produtora terceirizada).
  • Coordenar e revisar o pós-produção (edição, cortes, títulos e legendas).
  • Publicar os episódios completos e cortes em todas as plataformas.
  • Gerar insights e desdobramentos para novos conteúdos a partir dos episódios.

2. Bastidores:

  • Registrar bastidores, conversas, reuniões e momentos autênticos dos sócios e do time.
  • Criar vídeos no estilo "reality de bastidores", transformando situações reais em conteúdo leve e inspirador.
  • Adaptar os registros para diferentes plataformas (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts), utilizado formatos criativos.

3. Always On:

  • Produzir e publicar conteúdos semanais de autoridade e engajamento.
  • Criar e editar formatos próprios (como os carrosséis de conteúdo e vídeos curtos com ganchos fortes).
  • Monitorar trends e adaptar formatos em alta para a linguagem da Skidun e de seus sócios.
  • Trabalhar com pautas oportunas ("ângulos" de temas do momento) para reforçar a autoridade da marca e conectar com os produtos e serviços.
  • Apoiar na criação de conteúdos com o time interno (quando fizer sentido mostrar os bastidores da agência).

Qualificações

Requisitos técnicos:

  • Experiência anterior como Social Media (mínimo 2 anos).
  • Experiência com edição de vídeos em mobile (CapCut, InShot ou similares).
  • Domínio das principais redes (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn).
  • Boa escrita e sensibilidade estética.
  • Inglês intermediário a avançado (conversacional).

Perfil desejado:

  • Dinâmico(a), curioso(a) e com energia para acompanhar uma rotina intensa.
  • Perfil hands-on: grava, edita, posta, analisa.
  • Autogerenciável e organizado(a), com boa comunicação interpessoal.
  • Olhar criativo e curioso sobre marketing, comportamento e cultura digital.
  • Confortável em ambientes colaborativos e abertos (vai interagir direto com os sócios).

Informações Adicionais

Modelo de trabalho: Semi presencial

Segunda a quinta: presencial no escritório.

Sexta-feira: home office.

Possibilidade de viagens pontuais para gravações e eventos em São Paulo ou outros locais.

Local:  Barra da Tijuca - RJ

title: Vendedor(a) Júnior
description:
Conheça sua missão:

  • Realizar as reposições de mercadorias nos lineares/famílias e no "picking", executando os procedimentos básicos de "cheio, limpo, balizado, seguro", mantendo o correto endereçamento dos estoques no corredor, sugerindo os ajustes quando necessário e cumprindo as regras e procedimento de segurança, para garantir sempre uma grande disponibilidade de estoque para o cliente;
  • Realizar a troca das etiquetas e a confecção das balizagens e exposições das amostras dos produtos, seguindo o procedimento de "vejo, entendo, toco e compro", mantendo em perfeito estado as exposições dos displays, cross marketing e cartobags, facilitando assim o autoatendimento do cliente na frente do linear;

title: Operador(a) de Embalagem
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:

Sobre a Abbott
A Abbott é líder global em saúde, desenvolvendo uma ciência inovadora para melhorar a saúde das pessoas.  Estamos sempre olhando para o futuro, antecipando mudanças na ciência e em tecnologias médicas. 

Trabalhando na Abbott
Na Abbott, você pode realizar um trabalho importante, crescer e aprender, cuidar de si mesmo e de sua família, ser você mesmo e viver de maneira plena.  Você terá acesso a: 
•    Desenvolvimento de carreira em uma empresa internacional onde é possível crescer na carreira dos seus sonhos
•    Benefícios como Assistência Médica e Odontológica, Seguro de Vida, Previdência Privada, Subsidio de Medicamentos, Desconto para compra de ações da Abbott, entre outros.
•    Uma empresa reconhecida mundialmente como um ótimo lugar para se trabalhar em dezenas de países e nomeada como uma das empresas mais admiradas do mundo pela revista Fortune. 
•    Entre as melhores grandes empresas para se trabalhar, bem como um dos melhores lugares para se trabalhar nas categorias de diversidade mães que trabalham, executivas e cientistas. 
•    Políticas de trabalho flexíveis que permitem um equilíbrio saudável entre vida pessoal e profissional.
•    Um ambiente onde cada pessoa é ouvida e valorizada.

MISSÃO:

Executar as rotinas de suporte e operação dos diversos equipamentos de embalagem, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos, normas de qualidade, de segurança e custos fabris definidos.

ATRIBUIÇÕES:

  • Executar atividades de limpeza de equipamentos e áreas produtivas de acordo com os procedimentos e padrões definidos;
  • Preparar soluções diversas utilizadas na limpeza e nos processos produtivos;
  • Movimentar e abastecer com materiais as linhas de produção e centros de trabalho;
  • Enviar bulks e produtos acabados para os respectivos depósitos;
  • Executar atividades de descarte de resíduos industriais, conforme procedimentos vigentes;
  • Suportar a execução do programa de produção definido para os centros de trabalho da embalagem;
  • Cumprir as normas de qualidade e de segurança  durante toda a operação;
  • Cumprir as políticas e procedimentos referentes à sua atividade de acordo com os sistemas e processos de gestão implantados;
  • Conduzir as ações e decisões sob responsabilidade do cargo respeitando o Código de Conduta Ética da empresa;
  • Operação de equipamentos de baixa, média ou alta complexidade, conforme procedimentos operacionais vigentes;
  • Auxiliar os demais operadores nas atividades de setup (montagem e desmontagem de máquina, movimentação de peças, etc);
  • Executar a limpeza e conservação de peças e componetes específicos dos equipamentos produtivos;
  • Possuir domínio de Boas Práticas de Documentação (Ex. Preenchimento de logbooks, documentações de lote e etc);
  • Executar atividades de controle em processo e liberação de linha, conforme os procedimentos operacionais vigentes;
  • Executar os processos de embalagem de acordo com o descrito nos check lists de embalagem para cada lote de produto;
  • Realizar apontamentos de horas e entregas de quantidades no SAP, conforme procedimentos vigentes
  • Realizar ajustes mecânicos e trocas de formato de forma autônoma;
  • Inspecionar equipamentos de produção, auxiliando a manutenção na correção de defeitos e excutando manutenções corretivas e preventivas de baixa e média complexidade (exemplos: lubrificações, inspeções de máquina, troca de correias e rolamentos, etc);
  • Atuar na capacitação e treinamento de operadores mais novos em operação, ajustes e manutenções.

REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS

ESCOLARIDADE

Nível médio completo (2º grau)

CONHECIMENTOS:

- Boas Práticas de Fabricação (GMP)

- Processos produtivos farmacêuticos

Job Description Summary:

Job Summary

As RGM & Hubs Execution Lead, you will be responsible for leading the Revenue Growth Management (RGM) strategy and ensuring its flawless execution across ARTD. You will drive pricing, portfolio, and promotional discipline, while adapting commercial strategies to local hubs, with a special focus on the Central Zone Hub. Your mission is to balance profitable growth with executional excellence, ensuring the right value equation for consumers, customers, and the system.

Scope

  • OBPPC (Occasion, Brand, Package, Price, Channel): Define and deploy the right portfolio and price strategy across ARTD, ensuring the correct pack-price architecture by occasion and channel.
  • Get & Set Price: Guarantee execution of pricing strategies, balancing competitiveness and profitability in all markets.
  • Price Increases & Promotions: Design and implement disciplined pricing and promotional plans to maximize revenue and value creation.
  • Innovation Execution: Ensure innovation projects are successfully executed in-market, with proper pricing, visibility, and promotional support.
  • Price Execution Discipline: Drive system alignment and field execution of price and promotional guidelines to ensure consistency across channels.
  • Hub Central Zone: Hub Central Zone : Dedicate 30% of the role's focus to the Central Zone Hub, adapting and tailoring commercial strategies to local realities and ensuring excellence in execution.

Impact

  • Value Creation: Deliver a sustainable and healthy value equation through disciplined portfolio, pricing, and promotions.
  • Commercial Performance: Contribute directly to top-line and margin growth of ARTD through effective RGM execution.
  • Execution Excellence: Be the system leader in ensuring price and promotion strategies are implemented consistently across markets and hubs.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, or related field.
  • 7–9 years of experience in Revenue Growth Management and portfolio management.
  • Proven track record in leading OBPPC, pricing execution, and promotional strategies.
  • Strong analytical, financial modeling, and execution skills.

Core Competencies:

  • Ability to influence and negotiate with senior stakeholders across bottlers and commercial teams.
  • Leadership in translating RGM strategies into market execution.
  • Strong project management, governance, and disciplined follow-up.
  • Clear and effective communication with cross-functional and external partners.
  • Communication: Frequent influence and negotiation with bottlers and commercial stakeholders.

Skills:

Accountability, Business, Channels Strategy, Customer Relationships, Leadership, Price Management, Profitable Growth, Sales, Teamwork

We are taking deliberate action to nurture an inclusive culture that is grounded in our company purpose, to refresh the world and make a difference. We act with a growth mindset, take an expansive approach to what's possible and believe in continuous learning to improve our business and ourselves. We focus on four key behaviors – curious, empowered, inclusive and agile – and value how we work as much as what we achieve. We believe that our culture is one of the reasons our company continues to thrive after 130+ years. Visit Our Purpose and Vision to learn more about these behaviors and how you can bring them to life in your next role at Coca-Cola.

Sobre a BigDataCorp

A BigDataCorp é a maior datatech da América Latina, e democratiza, desde 2013, o acesso aos dados, aumentando possibilidades e certezas em um mundo repleto de incertezas.

Somos pioneiros na captura, estruturação, armazenamento e distribuição de dados no Brasil. Nosso processo é único. Já nascemos adequados à LGPD e às demais regulamentações, garantindo a origem das informações fornecidas, obtidas sempre de forma ética.

Sobre a área e a vaga

Os times das plataformas de engenharia de dados são responsáveis por disponibilizar todo o ferramental de tratamento das informações capturadas, permitindo a sua transformação em dados estruturados. Além do uso interno, essas ferramentas também estão integradas nos Plugins para uso dos clientes. Essas plataformas incluem os serviços de parsing e estruturação de dados, serviços de validação de dados, serviços de associação de entidades, armazenamento e gestão de passagens, e criação e gestão de metadados, dentre outros.

Requirements

Habilidades necessárias:

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou algum curso relacionado;

title: Partner Sales Manager
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing. 

We are hiring a Partner Sales Manager to be a key contributing team member within the growing Dell alliances organization. Large OEM or Independent Hardware Vendor (IHV) brands - Dell, HPE, IBM, Lenovo, Ericsson, Cisco, Fujitsu and many more - are major partners for Canonical. These companies build software-defined solutions to capitalize on global open source mandates and associated macro trends. Canonical's flagship product, Ubuntu, and its broader open source portfolio are key ingredients for these partners to realize their aspirations. Canonical represents the best platform for rapid open source innovation.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Global Alliances - Dell, the Partner Sales Manager will work closely with Dell and Canonical teams in various geographies to enable Dell teams, generate and transact opportunities, drive a Canonical agenda within Dell, and achieve targeted results. They are responsible to build trusted relationships with Dell, increase Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelize the partnership and drive business interactions from across persona - from engineer to CxO. They will often run customer workshops focused on particular initiatives at that customer, attend sales events, give public presentations and participate in executive engagements as coordinated by the Senior Director.

The role entails

  • Build strategic relationships and enable Dell teams on the partnership
  • Build pipeline and transact opportunities through Dell 
  • Grow Dell's awareness of open source capabilities on Canonical Ubuntu
  • Demonstrate a deep understanding of the Linux and cloud software ecosystem
  • Deliver on targets, objectives and provide a voice of the partner
  • Travel regularly - sometimes internationally - to drive partnerships in person
  • Align and support internal canonical field teams - identify, support, grow, transact
  • Expand existing footprint with Dell customers with an aim to upsell to broader portfolio
  • Support and contribute to broader strategy, initiatives and key campaigns as defined by the Senior Director

What we are looking for in you

  • Experience in alliance or indirect sales management roles
  • Autonomous, disciplined, hands-on, get-it-done mentality
  • Ability to capture customer requirements, evaluate gaps, identify and create opportunities
  • Passionate about Ubuntu products and mission
  • Comfortable in fast-paced and high pressure environments with measurable goals
  • Experience with Linux, virtualization, containers, and other cloud technologies
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Team player with superior accountability and customer support skills
  • Credibility and working knowledge of Dell - its products, go-to-market motion, and field
  • Experience managing cross-functional teams and track record of operational excellence
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
  • Hands on experience with and Google Suite a plus

What we offer colleagues


We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical


Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

title: Rust Engineering Lead

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring Rust Engineering Leads of all levels of experience to drive the adoption of this exciting language into the full range of Canonical offerings, starting with Ubuntu but also our own projects and open source offerings. We see Rust as an important new language for system level services and capabilities, and a natural evolution path for the sort of software that would traditionally have been written in C or C++. We believe that there is an opportunity to rethink the foundations of future Linux systems with Rust as a central driver of change in everything from the system firmware and embedded software, bootloaders, up through the kernel and input handling, all the way to the desktop. 

We also want to ensure that Ubuntu is the very best platform for Rust development, offering easy access to the widest range of tooling and capabilities that support cutting edge open source and enterprise development.

This job posting is our general process for Rust engineers of all levels of seniority, for all relevant teams at Canonical. Apply here if you are an exceptional software engineer who prefers to work in Rust. After the first round of interviews we'll find the best fit product team at Canonical for you to progress your application based on your personal interests.

Canonical has substantial projects in Python, Go, C, C++ and we are starting to invest in Rust. For front-end development we prefer React and Flutter.

Join us in our mission to deliver innovative open-source solutions to individuals and enterprises around the world. We expect the highest engineering standards and strong motivation to get things done well in a fully home-based and distributed environment. title: Marketing Coordinator
description:
Our Mission
Launched in 2012, Tinder revolutionized how people meet, growing from 1 match to one billion matches in just two years. This rapid growth demonstrates its ability to fulfill a fundamental human need: real connection. Today, the app has been downloaded over 630 million times, leading to over 97 billion matches, serving approximately 50 million users per month in 190 countries and 45+ languages - a scale unmatched by any other app in the category. In 2024, Tinder won four Effie Awards for its first-ever global brand campaign, "It Starts with a Swipe""
Our Values
One Team, One Dream We work hand-in-hand, building Tinder for our members. We succeed together when we work collaboratively across functions, teams, and time zones, and think outside the box to achieve our company vision and mission.
Own It We take accountability and strive to make a positive impact in all aspects of our business, through ownership, innovation, and a commitment to excellence.
Never Stop Learning We cultivate a culture where it's safe to take risks. We seek out input, share honest feedback, celebrate our wins, and learn from our mistakes in order to continue improving.
Spark Solutions We're problem solvers, focusing on how to best move forward when faced with obstacles. We don't dwell on the past or on the issues at hand, but instead look at how to stay agile and overcome hurdles to achieve our goals.
Embrace Our Differences We are intentional about building a workplace that reflects the rich diversity of our members. By leveraging different perspectives and other ways of thinking, we build better experiences for our members and our team.
About the Role
We're looking for a Marketing Coordinator to join Tinder's LATAM Marketing team in Brazil. This is a hands-on and supportive role, perfect for someone early in their career who's eager to learn, grow, and make an impact. You'll help the team bring Tinder to life through marketing campaigns, activations, and cultural moments that connect with young people in authentic ways.
This role is a great opportunity to gain experience across different areas of marketing, from social to experiential, while being part of a creative and fast-moving team. As you grow in the position, you'll have the chance to take on more ownership of projects and initiatives.
What You'll Do
  • Support the execution of integrated marketing campaigns (social, digital, experiential, partnerships).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (social, PR, comms, growth, product marketing) to keep projects moving.
  • Help track and report on campaign performance.
  • Assist with project management, timelines, budgets, and vendor coordination  including working with partners in Finance and Legal.
  • Stay close to cultural trends, social platforms, and Gen Z behaviors to inspire new ideas.
  • Support the team with day-to-day marketing operations and admin tasks.
    • What We're Looking For
  • 1–3 years of experience in marketing, advertising, or communications (agency or brand side).
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English.
  • Strong connection with social media platforms, digital culture, and emerging trends.
  • Proactive, curious, and ready to learn in a fast-paced environment.

    None
    Why Join Us
    At Tinder, we believe in creating meaningful connections, not only for our members but also within our team. As a Marketing Coordinator, you'll gain hands-on experience across multiple areas of marketing, with opportunities to learn, grow, and take on new responsibilities over time. You'll be part of a passionate, creative, and collaborative LATAM marketing squad, helping shape how Tinder shows up in Brazilst
    Commitment to Inclusion
    At Tinder, we don't just accept difference, we celebrate it. We strive to build a workplace that reflects the rich diversity of our members around the world, and we value unique perspectives and backgrounds. Even if you don't meet all the listed qualifications, we invite you to apply and show us how your skills could transfer. Tinder is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace where we welcome people of all sexes, gender identities, races, ethnicities, disabilities, and other lived experiences. Learn more here:

title: Field Service Technician
description:
Job Summary:

The Field Service Technician installs, commissions, monitors, diagnoses and repairs pumps, mechanical seals and other Flowserve equipment in various industries, such as oil and gas, petrochemical, steel, mining, sanitation, etc., depending on our customers' area of operation. In this position, the Field Service Technician (FST) offers real-time technical support at customers' plants and provides recommendations for repairs, upgrades and replacements of parts and equipment.

The FST is actively engaged in solving problems and implementing solutions at customer sites. Our team of Field Service Technicians is the face of Flowserve and we rely on them to provide world-class service to our customers, creating a lasting competitive advantage for our products and services.

Responsibilities:

  •     Perform direct, in-person service calls in response to customer requests;

  •     Assess mechanical problems and take action to resolve them promptly;

  •     Work side-by-side with customer personnel and lead work teams as required;

  •     Supervising the complete repair cycle: disassembly, cleaning, inspection, repair and assembly;

  •     Ensure that equipment is installed successfully and on schedule;

  •     Checking equipment before commissioning and start-up and evaluating performance during and after equipment start-up;

  •     Monitoring the maintenance and performance of Flowserve equipment;

  •     Guide customers on proper procedures for operating and maintaining Flowserve products;

  •     Collaborate effectively with Flowserve support organizations, including repair centers, customer service and sales engineering;

  •     Maintain and submit organized and accurate records, including daily reports, jobs quoted, jobs performed, and time and materials charged;

  •     Other duties as assigned;

Requirements:

  •     Mechanical Technician with active CFT;

  •     Experience as a Field Service Technician in a refinery industry;

  •     Knowledge of industrial applications and operations of pumps, valves, seals, actuators and mechanical equipment;

  •     Experience in installing mechanical equipment;

  •     Experience in repairing pump equipment, installing mechanical seals, changing seal faces, gaskets, rings, etc..;

  •     Knowledge of mechanical adjustment by backlash and interference;

  •     Knowledge of metrology and the use of measuring instruments such as pachymeters, external and internal micrometers, tubular micrometers, dial gauges and dial gauges;

  •     Proven ability to read and correctly interpret mechanical technical drawings, cutting drawings and dimensional drawings of equipment;

  •     Good Outlook, Word and Excel skills;

  •     Intermediate English

  •     An active driver's license with a good driving record is essential for the job;

  •     Willingness to travel and ship, including globally, for long periods;

  •     Willingness to work overtime as required to minimize impact on customers;

  •     Proven ability to correctly read and interpret mechanical technical drawings, cutting drawings and dimensional drawings of equipment;

Desirable Skills:

  •     Advanced English and/or intermediate Spanish desirable;

  •     Professional certifications in this area.

title: Consultor Técnico Vacinas Campanhas
description:

O Consultor Técnico de Vacinas Campanhas atua como especialista na execução das campanhas de vacinação adulta incluindo campanhas nacionais, institucionais e colaborativas.

Atua focando no engajamento de stakeholders externos com o objetivo de gerar oportunidades de campanhas e ampliar o alcance das ações de vacinação do adulto no Brasil, entendendo o ecossistema de saúde e do mercado de prevenção, e gerenciando adequadamente contas existentes e potenciais, tendo autonomia para a gestão dos recursos a seu cargo. Essa posição ficará baseada em Brasília.

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

title: Sr. Growth Marketing Manager
description:
About Us

At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 250 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data

For more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy-to-use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data, quickly, dependably, and at scale. And today, the data we extract helps thousands of organizations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. Today, over 3,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.
Why You're Here

You'll be the engine behind getting Zyte's story and brand out into the world. Your mission is to turn content, of all types, into fuel for growth—promoting and repurposing content, distributing it across our ICP communities and marketing channels, and ensuring Zyte stays top-of-mind for developers, data teams and data buyers.

Requirements

You're here to:

  • Amplify and reinforce the Zyte brand as an authority in web scraping.
  • Drive maximum reach and engagement for Zyte content.
  • Reach our ICPs where they are, at scale.

What You'll Deliver

  • Content Amplification: Turn Zyte content into intelligent cross-channel campaigns and ensure it reaches the right audiences.
  • AI-Powered Execution: Leverage AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, etc.) to repurpose content at scale.
  • Channel Identification: Build presence in ecosystems like Reddit, Hackernews, Stack Overflow, LinkedIn, X, , substack, and emerging platforms (which you'll need to identify).
  • Social Media & Community: Manage Zyte's social presence with an eye for authenticity and cutting-edge social plays.
  • Campaign Velocity: Launch fast, iterative campaigns with tailored messaging per channel—no bloated briefs.

Quantitative

  • New audience growth (traffic, reach, social engagement)
  • Content engagement (CTR, CVR, downloads, shares)

Qualitative

  • Innovation in AI-driven content repurposing
  • Speed and creativity of campaign execution
  • Ability to crack web data professional ecosystems with authentic content
  • Cross-team collaboration and impact on broader demand gen goals

Who You Are

  • Technical ICP-Focused: You know what resonates with developers and data professionals—and what falls flat.
  • Channel Fluent: You know how to break into niche ecosystems with the right tone, content, and delivery.
  • AI-Native: You use AI as a natural part of your workflow, not an afterthought. We need to see this in your mentality.
  • Campaign Writing Aficionado: You know what it takes to take a great piece of content and ensure our target audiences see it and appreciate it. This includes the ability to repurpose, identify alternative formats (video, infographics, podcast episode, etc.), and amplify the core messages.
  • Fast-Moving: You value execution speed and iteration over perfect briefs.

Requirements

  • 5+ years B2B SaaS marketing, ideally with developer or technical products
  • Strong copywriting + AI-assisted content skills
  • Track record of fast, iterative campaign launches across channels, with a strong working knowledge of channel nuances.
  • (BONUS) Familiarity with web scraping, data extraction, or developer tools

Tech You'll work with

  • HubSpot, Microsoft Clarity, Google Analytics
  • Figma, Notion, Google Workspace
  • ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other LLMs for message generation and ideation

How We Work

We move fast, learn loud, and optimize often. Campaigns are built around business goals—not bloated processes. You'll have the autonomy to test, iterate, and scale ideas that work.

Benefits

As a new Zytan, you will:

Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multi-cultural team.

Have the freedom and flexibility to work from where you do your best work.

Attend conferences and meet with team members from across the globe.

Work with cutting-edge open source technologies and tools.

title: Business Services Team Manager
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few roles based in offices.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring a Business Services Team Manager to lead efficient and effective travel, logistics, event, scheduling, expense policy and administration.

This executive role requires outstanding coordination, planning, decision-making, budgeting, procurement, reporting and management. It is a fast-paced and complex operation in the tech industry.

We coordinate large-scale company events which involve travel for hundreds of people from 80+ countries. We run such events four times a year, a significant investment in our ability to shape culture, teamwork, execution plans and strategy. Our team is responsible for travel procurement and logistics, ensuring that these events run efficiently and safely. Visas, travel complications and unexpected situations make this a complex operation to run efficiently, demanding a rigorous approach and high work ethic in the team.

This team also serves as an independent check on expense claim approval, ensuring fairness and consistency across teams and countries. This requires integrity, transparency and accountability, and a willingness to set and politely defend the same expectations of the most senior and most junior colleagues.

Together these responsibilities amount to tens of millions in operational costs and a significant number of tactical and operational decisions.

Our team also provides traditional 'EA' services for company leads, though they do this across departments and as a consistent service rather than as personal assistants; they set and deliver to expectations on specific kinds of work. They schedule meetings, coordinate monthly reports, handle delegated approvals for travel and expenses, work across teams, coordinate with suppliers, and run small projects or initiatives.

Location: Worldwide, home based, except in locations where we have an office, such as London, Taipei and Beijing

Leadership and accountability


This team has a direct impact on every team at Canonical. It is important for them to have excellent judgment and interpersonal skills, the confidence to hold people accountable and defend positions of policy, and the work ethic to move quickly through a large volume of work. It is also essential that the team participate in every company event, from the planning and venue selection stages to scheduling, operations and safety reviews, to ensure that they establish personal relationships with team leaders and can ensure these events run smoothly.

As a manager, your team would be responsible for

  • Travel approvals, logistics and operations
  • Expense review in line with policies
  • Planning of complex company events four times a year
  • Company offices that provide executive briefing and operational facilities
  • Our global duty of care, health and safety programs with comprehensive policies and practices

What we are looking for

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • An undergraduate degree in a technical or business subject
  • Drive, and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Leadership and management skills
  • Demonstrable good judgement in matters involving money, policy and in-person interactions
  • Ability to work in a global, multicultural organisation
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility
  • Responsibility, accountability, thoughtfulness and self-awareness
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments 
  • Ability to travel up to four times a year, for company events up to two weeks long

Additional skills that you might also bring

  • Travel industry experience
  • Project management experience
  • Event management and operations experience
  • Business and corporate administration experience

What we offer you


We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical


Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer


We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Billing Analyst II
description:
About Us
Airswift is the leading workforce solutions provider to the STEM industries. For over 40 years Airswift has been transforming lives through the provision of international workforce solutions to STEM industries. Today, we are an integrated team of over 900 employees across 37 countries, supporting over 8,000 contractors globally.
We are a people business – we transform lives through the world of work. We care about wellbeing, community engagement and our planet – we plant a tree for every person placed in a job globally We have a passion for growth, including investing in the development of our people.
We support professionals looking for jobs with exceptional firms in the technology, construction, and engineering sectors.
It's a hybrid schedule (3 days at the office per week) in Rio de Janeiro - Cinelândia.

Role Description

The Billing Analyst will have responsibility for specific client accounts in Airswift's sales ledger covering the North American region. You will join a strong team based in our Rio de Janeiro office and will be tasked with ensuring fully compliant and timely billing for clients under your remit. 

Principle Accountabilities:

  • Assure billing for the assigned client portfolio.
  • Adhere to client billing requirements as per contracts and work orders, call off orders, purchase orders, etc.
  • Liaise closely with consultants on new clients and new client billing requirements.
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of billing, including recharges to clients.
  • Ensure timely delivery of invoices to clients along with a variety of supporting documentation.
  • Ensure reporting to the Supervisor of any un-invoiced, missed, or incorrect amount that is not billed timely manner to the client or becomes aged.
  • Ensure timely response to clients (external and internal) and report to the direct Supervisor of specific customer requests for timely delivery.
  • Report on funded invoices to the billing supervisor accurately and in a timely fashion.
  • Deliver pro forma invoicing, pre-approvals, SES, etc.
  • Ensure all banking information is correct on invoices as per funded or non-funded category, currency, and billing entity.
  • Follow up on invoices emailed to clients or via consultants to confirm receipt.
  • Reconcile client VMS (vendor management system) with an internal invoicing system to ensure invoices are correctly submitted.
  • Monitor the status of invoices that were previously sent by email, portal, or VMS systems for any rejections that require correction.
  • Ensure intercompany invoices are issued correctly and timely manner between Airswift's legal entities.
  • Work to the month-end deadlines.
  • Compare invoices from Tempest (payroll and billing system) to invoices generated in Amalto to ensure all relevant information has been saved in SharePoint and maintained in line with auditing requirements.
  • Import invoices to Dynamics 365 (financial ERP system), and balance payroll and billing Tempest to D365, ensuring all billing has been captured.
  • Complete submittal logs in a timely fashion and attend weekly submittal meetings with the Billing Supervisor.
  • Ensure all invoices and backups are filed in a shared drive and maintained.
  • Complete queries in a 48-hour turnaround (outside of main invoicing schedules) and maintain and complete query log.
  • Liaise with payroll to validate any payroll adjustments affected by credit notes and complete credit note logs for auditing purposes.
  • Review new client contracts with the Billing Supervisor to ensure all requirements are captured.
  • Ensure Bullhorn (client management system) data is correct and highlight errors to consultants and service teams accordingly.
  • Meet accuracy targets in line with KPIS.
  • Purchase order and work order analysis.
  • Maintain and deliver 3rd party reconciliations and advise the billing supervisor of details to pay – this is working with credit control to ascertain paid invoices (pay when paid basis).
  • Communicate with various parties of the PO analysis ceilings to ensure timely delivery of either renewed PO value or extended PO.
  • Support function for MIDE region invoicing as and when required.
  • Be fully involved in working with credit control to reduce DSO and improve the liquidity of Airswift for the North American region.
  • Follow company policies and procedures, guidelines, and standards.
  • Ad hoc duties as and when required.

Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:

  • 2+ years of experience in billing
  • Knowledge of multi-currency transactions.
  • Knowledge of VAT and WHT is beneficial.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Good communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a challenging environment with the ability to meet deadlines and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Experience in liaising with various internal departments.
  • Focused and dedicated mindset.
  • Good team player with the ability to drive changes and improvements.
  • Knowledge of funding and non-funding.
  • Knowledge of withholding tax (training provided).
  • Excel and Word knowledge are preferred, but training will be given.

What we can offer you

  • Attractive monthly base salary + competitive commission/performance bonus.
  • Genuine career progression opportunities, either locally or globally
  • World-class training programmes and development opportunities.
  • Virtual Onboarding Events exclusively for new hires.
  • Team driven environment, supportive culture with a focus on work-life balance.
  • Career breaks available after one year.
  • Real time recognition through our employee reward platform.
  • Mental Health First Aiders to signpost you to support when you need it.
  • Yearly destination trips as part of our High Flyers program (Dubai, Buenos Aires, etc…)
  • Charity days for various important causes such as Relay for Life and Earth Day.
Our Core Values:
  • Growth  - In life and business, one must grow to flourish and achieve high ambitions. Growth requires change, challenge, risk and sacrifice - we will always choose growth.
  • Life  – Above all else, we value life. The quality of life, both in and outside of work, profoundly influences our well-being and our impact on the world.
  • Excellence  - We deliver, holding ourselves accountable for results. Our customers see excellence in everything we do.
  • Integrity  - We are ethical, open, honest and authentic. People trust us to do the right thing for the right reason.
Visit our website and social media to find out more - 
Disclaimer
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. All personnel may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed.
Diversity & Inclusion
At Airswift, we believe that diversity is critical to our success and makes us a great place to work.  We are committed to building an equal opportunity workplace, the more inclusive we are - the better our work will be.

title: Remote - Asset Resolution Counsel (Lawyer)
description:
About World Business Lenders )

World Business Lenders (WBL) provides general purpose short-term real estate collateralized commercial loans to a broad customer base comprised of small and medium sized businesses throughout the United States that lack access to traditional funding. WBL services its loan portfolio and loan portfolios for third parties, specializing in the management of non-performing loan pools and REO.

WBL is a U.S.-based company with a 100% remote workforce.

This is a remote Contract/Consultant position.

Working hours will be 9:00am-6:00pm Eastern Time, Monday through Friday.

The job requires excellent oral and written command of the English language. Resumes must be submitted in English.

Location:

  • 100% Remote for Turkey, LATAM and India

Essential Functions:

  • Manage and monitor a non-performing real estate collateralized commercial loan portfolio, including REO, toward most effective and efficient resolution
  • Supervise, train and develop Asset Resolution Department staff
  • Conduct proactive and effective portfolio management in accordance with established performance standards
  • Monitor and manage commercial litigation/bankruptcy/foreclosure activities, functions and deadlines
  • Direct/monitor/liaise with in-house and outside attorneys, collection agencies and other vendors that support the loss mitigation effort
  • Interact with customers and their counsel
  • Negotiate and propose settlement agreements and bidding instructions
  • Monitor loss mitigation workout performance and loss severity trends
  • Implement and communicate loss mitigation decisions
  • Maintain delinquency and loss mitigation reporting, including trend analysis and assessment
  • Conduct comprehensive analysis of debtors' financial position, credit status, personal background, and historical payment performance
  • Facilitate negotiation and conflict resolution
  • Perform extensive quarterly review of portfolio being managed to confirm or reassess recovery estimates
  • Monitor related expenses (taxes, maintenance, utilities, fees, etc.) and timely propose protective advances
  • Participate in budget preparation for the Asset Resolution Department
  • Other projects and duties as assigned.

Requirements

  • Law degree (from a nationally accredited U.S. law school is a must)
  • Experience working in commercial litigation/bankruptcy/foreclosure/real estate loss mitigation
  • Demonstrated ability to successfully manage non-performing loan pools and REO
  • Experience supervising/developing/mentoring a case management staff
  • Litigation experience and familiarity with litigation management tools
  • Strong organization, decision-making and negotiation skills
  • Strong knowledge of applicable U.S. legal/regulatory guidelines, including bankruptcy and foreclosure (Experience working for a US company is a must)
  • Demonstrated analytical and reasoning skills, and innovative approach to solving both practical and theoretical problems
  • Proficiency in all Microsoft Office applications
  • Strong work ethic with ability to thrive in a dynamic, deadline-driven environment
  • You must have your own laptop or desktop to use (the company does not supply equipment)
  • Excellent English fluency and communication skills, both written and verbal

Benefits

  • CONTRACT/CONSULTANCY POSITION
  • PTO Available
  • USD salary
  • 100% Work from home

title: Analista de Engenharia
description:
Sobre a empresa:

Uma indústria de ideias a serviço do progresso.
Liderança. Confiança. Expertise.

Fundada em 1954 com o objetivo inicial de atuar nas áreas de investigação e sondagem de solos, a Sondotécnica foi, ao longo do tempo, ampliando sua gama de serviços, passando a oferecer estudos de barragens e ingressou na consultoria para a construção de hidrelétricas. Foi pioneira nas áreas de hidrologia, oceanografia e transporte de sedimentos, também adquiriu conhecimento de estruturas, elaborando projetos de edifícios, complexos industriais e até pontes. Com o forte investimento em pesquisa, treinamento e qualificação, a empresa diversificou sua área de atuação e hoje presta serviços em vários segmentos de infraestrutura, com foco na execução dos projetos, gerenciamento, fiscalização e supervisão de obras. A Sondotécnica hoje é líder em consultoria de engenharia no Brasil, com mais de 3 mil projetos executados e mais de 400 clientes atendidos. Hoje, a Sondotécnica oferece sua expertise para empreendimentos nos setores de: – Transporte – Saneamento – Habitação – Urbanização – Energia – Indústria – Meio Ambiente – Irrigação.

Sobre a vaga

  • Auxílio no dimensionamento e detalhamento de projetos de estruturas de contenção, aterros sobre solos moles, estabilidade de taludes de solos e rochosos, fundações e estruturas enterradas, instrumentação, rebaixamento de lençol freático;
  • Programação, acompanhamento, controle de medição e interpretação de investigações geológico-geotécnicas;

Requisitos:

  • Formação: Graduação de Engenharia Civil. Desejável especialização em Geotecnia.
  • Conhecimentos: Conhecimento em AutoCAD CIVIL 3D, Revit, Slope/W (GeoStudio), Slide ou equivalente e Pacote Office. Conhecimento em modelagem por elementos finitos e experiência com projeto na área de infraestrutura serão diferenciais.
  • Experiência: Desejável experiência com projetos geotécnicos na área de estruturas de contenções, estabilidade de taludes, tratamento de aterros sobre solos moles e fundações. Familiaridade com BIM será um diferencial.

Modalidade: Presencial - Botafogo.

title: Propagandista Consumo Virtual Jr
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We're a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we've grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne, Panadol, Advil, Voltaren, Theraflu, Otrivin, and Centrum – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.

Now it's time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

Quer fazer parte de uma empresa líder mundial em saúde do consumidor que tem como propósito entregar a maior saúde diária com humanidade? Quer contribuir para impactar a vida de bilhões de pessoas por meio de grandes e reconhecidas marcas, como Sensodyne, Centrum, Advil, Eno, Sonrisal, Corega, CataflamPro, Sonridor e outras, e poder ir além em um ambiente que celebra a diversidade?

Então, confira a oportunidade abaixo e venha fazer parte do nosso time Haleon

  • Manter o cadastro dos profissionais atualizados, buscando garantir os principais prescritores do seu setor.
  • Interpretar as informações sobre os produtos Haleon e concorrentes obtidas em diversos canais (PDV, farmácias, consultórios s e clínicas) para elaboração do seu planejamento;
  • Participar de congressos odontológicos promovendo os produtos Haleon;
  • Gerênciar e garantir a realização de eventos para dentistas em instituições de ensino de acordo com a meta e estratégia traçada para os distritos;

description:
Are you excited to support corporate commercial legal departments and help them succeed in a sales environment?

Can you work independently and handle the pressure of a sales environment?

About our Team

We work within the Legal Department, which is composed of lawyers, paralegals, and specialists committed to the professional growth and career development of our team.

About the Role

Our Commercial Sales Legal Counsel will be a business partner to our Elsevier Academic and Government and Corporate Sales teams in North America with some support to our Latin American region. You will provide legal support and guidance to our Sales teams, and work closely with our contract managers and sales support teams and will be part of the Elsevier Legal team reporting into the General Counsel EMEA APAC LA.

Legal support has a strong focus on commercial transactions interacting directly with our customers. You will also help to deliver training, projects and initiatives to our organization, acting as a trusted business partner.

Responsibilities

  • Providing support on transactional matters including legal advice, contract negotiation and drafting
  • Provide best in practice professional legal services aligned with the strategic drivers of the business ensuring significant impact.
  • Builds relationships with the aim to become the trusted business partner including stakeholder management
  • Act as a role model in the team, actively endorsing team operating principles including on teamwork and collaboration, change, working in an international environment, and open and meaningful communication.

Requirements

  • Have substantial in-house legal experience (7 to 10 years+) and preferably also experience working for a law firm.
  • Have experience working in an international environment.
  • Have extensive experience working in the United States and/or with North American customers.
  • Have excellent academic qualifications and substantial relevant experience in providing legal advice and support to businesses.
  • Have a well-developed technical knowledge about relevant areas of law. Could apply that technical expertise to practical matters. Knowledge of IP, licensing including Software as a Service contracts, if possible
  • Be accustomed to communicating complex legal and commercial issues clearly and concisely in a way that is readily understandable and can be acted upon by the business.
  • Be a collaborative team player who demonstrates leadership qualities appropriate for a member of the Legal Department.
  • Fluent in Spanish and English and if possible, Portuguese in both writing and speaking.

Work in a way that works for you

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate.

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

Working for you

  • Private Medical/Dental Plan

A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals' advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. title: Bid Manager
description:
Overview

WELCOME TO SITA

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward—we're proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work by our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.

Are you ready to love your job?

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM

Manages new and renewal business opportunities related to managed, major and/or complex solutions. Plays an active part in the entire proposal project life cycle, challenge solutions and drive best practice for major or complex deals. Ensures that SITA is portrayed professionally and with credibility

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Validates the qualification of opportunities and monitors qualification status at all stages during the bid process.
  • Analyses and understands the customer's detailed requirements in order to develop the optimum win strategy and associated appropriate level of response in order to successfully bid and win each contract.
  • Develops the overall bid project plan and builds and manages the virtual Bid Team to achieve the bid deliverables in an effective and efficient manner. This includes leading the process of identifying potential subcontractors or partners and selecting / negotiating / contracting with such parties under the guidance of senior regional / commercial management.
  • Owns and reviews the overall response to customer, assessing the risk to delivering a successful bid project, and ensuring that these are addressed appropriately under the guidance of senior regional / commercial management.
  • Coordinates the negotiation team in the pre-contract stage with the Customer, including the setting up of appropriate commercial partnership agreements and underpinning contracts to support contract deliverables whilst ensuring that the relevant internal expertise is involved in the closure of commercial, financial and legal issues with the customer.
  • Develops plans to ensure a smooth transition from the bid team to the delivery and implementation team upon contract award, including comprehensive and clear documentation of all aspects of the solution.
  • Helps obtains solution approvals (financial, technical etc) and ensures the proposed solution is carried out in accordance with the appropriate corporate guidelines.
  • Communicates progress regularly and clearly to the relevant SITA senior management and stakeholders, ensuring that major issues are escalated and addressed.
Qualifications

WHO YOU ARE 

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional qualifications in Economics, Business Administration, Finance or Legal.
  • Verifiable 5 + years of experience in commercial or similar roles with strong project management skills across multiple teams in multiple locations is required
  • Must have Proposal Management, Sales, Business Development or Account Management experience.
  • Experience in aviation industry or IT is a plus.
  • Hands-on experience and verifiable experience in complex bids & proposals - in purchasing and/or sales - including exposure to the vendor side.
  • Relevant understanding of the airport and/or airline operation is an advantage.
  • Experience in developing successful relationships at Senior Manager level.
  • Preferably having worked in a multinational company.  

WHAT WE OFFER

We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.

Flex Week: Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)

Flex Day: Make your workday suit your life and plans.

Flex-Location: Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.

Employee Wellbeing: We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health - a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.

Professional Development: Level up your skills with our training platforms, including LinkedIn Learning

Competitive Benefits: Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.

SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self-identify in the application process.

title: Digital Catalog Strategy Sr Manager
description:
About Sony Music Entertainment Brazil


Sony Music Entertainment Brazil is one of the country's leading entertainment groups and part of the global Sony Music Entertainment family. Our mission is to drive music and culture forward by connecting artists and fans through innovation, creativity, and operational excellence. We operate across all segments of the music industry, from developing new talent to celebrating an iconic catalog, always with the goal of inspiring and transforming through music.

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Digital Catalog Strategy, who is passionate about music and deeply connected to the digital landscape. This person will be responsible for leading strategic initiatives aimed at enhancing the performance, visibility, and relevance of the company's catalog across streaming platforms, social media, and other digital channels.

The primary focus of this role is to maximize engagement and consumption of the catalog, from timeless classics to major hits, connecting different generations of fans through content, storytelling, and digital innovation.

What you'll do:

  • Lead a diverse team, fostering integration with local (Sony and Som Livre) and international teams.
  • Be responsible for catalog repertoire KPIs and overall performance goals for Sony/Som Livre.
  • Test and model new strategies to grow catalog music audiences across major digital platforms (Spotify, YouTube, Amazon, Apple, Deezer, etc.).
  • Plan and manage the area's budget efficiently, investing in: content marketing, paid media, channel optimization strategies, creative projects and events, page and game creation,influencer partnerships and other innovative initiatives.
  • Ensure the effective execution and tracking of action plans, campaigns, projects, and events.
  • Analyze performance and conversion results, implementing data-driven improvements.
  • Collaborate closely with other Sony teams (Sales, Playlist Strategy, BI, Creative, Media, Marketing, and A&R) to analyze user behavior, generate insights, test hypotheses (A/B testing), and optimize revenue by reducing media dependency.
  • Stay up to date with market trends in music, digital marketing, and UX.

Who you are:

  • Loves music and is an active user of streaming platforms.
  • Is results-driven and focused on the company's key KPIs.
  • Has strong strategic thinking and structured reasoning.
  • Demonstrates excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Responds calmly under pressure and manages conflicts and risks effectively.
  • Communicates clearly with cross-functional stakeholders at multiple levels, building trust and credibility.
  • Can create compelling, storytelling-driven presentations.
  • Is proactive, self-motivated, and enjoys sharing knowledge and fostering team collaboration.
  • Manages time and resources efficiently, setting priorities and delegating effectively.
  • Is engaged in developing the team, offering fair and constructive feedback, and empowering people to make responsible and assertive decisions.
  • Is curious, creative, and constantly seeking innovative ways to act in the market.
  • Shows resilience when facing challenges, adapts easily to change, and stays aligned with evolving business needs.
  • Demonstrates self-awareness, works on personal development points, and identifies opportunities for professional growth.

Requirements:

  • Fluent English and Intermediate Spanish.
  • Degree in Engineering, Economics, Data Science, Marketing, Advertising, or Business Administration.
  • Postgraduate degree or MBA in Marketing and/or Business Administration.
  • 10+ years of professional experience.
  • 3+ years of team management experience.
  • Strong background in Marketing, Digital, or Growth within music, tech, media, digital marketing agencies, or social media companies.
  • Advanced knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets and PowerPoint/Canva.
  • Experience with Google Ads (Search, Display, and YouTube), Facebook Ads, YouTube Analytics, and Facebook Insights.
  • Experience using AI tools such as Copilot, ChatGPT, or Gemini to increase work efficiency.
  • Knowledge of SEO strategies, UI/UX best practices, viral marketing, content marketing, and growth hacking.

What we give you:

  • Join an inclusive, collaborative, and global community where you can channel your passion every day.
  • Work in a modern environment designed to inspire productivity, creativity, and teamwork, empowering you to do your best work.
  • Benefit from investment in your growth and professional development, helping you thrive within our vibrant community.
  • Enjoy the freedom to accelerate progress, innovate, and shape what's next.
  • Be part of a company that drives positive change and contributes to social impact, diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives.
  • Access a comprehensive benefits package that supports you and your family, from wellness programs to paid time off that helps balance your professional and personal life.
  • Enjoy additional time off during the end-of-year holidays.

Somos a Base Exchange, a futura nova Bolsa de Valores do Brasil, com sede no Rio de Janeiro.

No seu dia a dia você irá

  • Criar indicadores e alertas de supervisão de mercado de bolsa;

O que você precisa:

  • Experiência na configuração de sistemas de supervisão de mercado, criação de indicadores e alertas automáticos para detecção de práticas irregulares e análise de padrões atípicos de negociação;
  • Vivência na investigação de operações atípicas, envolvendo indícios de manipulação de preços, criação de condições artificiais, insider trading, wash trades, spoofing, layering e money pass, com base em dados de mercado e registros de negociação;

  • Inglês avançado.

  • Certificações profissionais como CPA-20, CEA, CNPI, CGA, ou certificações internacionais relacionadas a mercado de capitais.
  • MBA ou pós-graduação em Mercado Financeiro, Risco, Compliance, Regulação ou Direito do Mercado de Capitais;

title: recepcionista para clinica medica
description:
A principal função de uma recepcionista de clínica médica é ser o primeiro ponto de contato entre os pacientes e a clínica, realizando atendimento, agendamentos e organização geral para garantir um bom fluxo de trabalho e a satisfação do paciente. As tarefas incluem atender chamadas, recepcionar presencialmente, agendar consultas e exames, confirmar agendamentos e lidar com questões administrativas, como contato com convênios para autorizações.

Funções administrativas e de organização

  • Agendamento:
     Marcar consultas, exames e procedimentos, além de confirmar os compromissos com os pacientes.
  • Atendimento:
     Atender pacientes e visitantes presencialmente, por telefone e por e-mail, respondendo a dúvidas e orientando-os.
  • Documentação:
     Organizar guias de consultas e exames, abrir fichas ambulatoriais e, quando necessário, contactar convênios para autorizações.
  • Gestão de fluxo:
     Controlar a entrada e saída de pacientes das salas de atendimento e auxiliar na organização dos espaços.

Funções de atendimento e relacionamento

  • Acolhimento:
     Recepcionar os pacientes de forma acolhedora, prestando um atendimento cordial e humanizado.
  • Comunicação:
     Transmitir informações com clareza, tanto para os pacientes quanto para a equipe médica e administrativa.
  • Resolução de problemas:
     Lidar com situações difíceis com tato, paciência e boa comunicação.
  • Feedback:
     Contribuir para o bem-estar do paciente enquanto ele aguarda o atendimento, sendo responsável pela primeira impressão que ele tem da clínica.

title: Analista de Planejamento Financeiro Sênior
description:
A pessoa
Analista de Planejamento Financeiro Sênior
será o ponto focal para todas as análises financeiras do grupo. Será responsável por consolidar e analisar os resultados após o fechamento contábil, elaborando apresentações e reportes direcionados às lideranças, Diretoria e Conselho.

Além disso, essa posição terá um papel estratégico na condução de estudos de viabilidade de projetos, modelagem financeira de novos negócios e iniciativas de M&A, apoiando a tomada de decisão e o crescimento sustentável da companhia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Elaborar o orçamento anual base zero, garantindo acuracidade e alinhamento com as diretrizes estratégicas da companhia;

  • Construir, atualizar e aprimorar os modelos financeiros das empresas do grupo, incluindo projeções de DRE, Balanço Patrimonial e Fluxo de Caixa;

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia, Administração ou Economia;
  • Experiência nas áreas de Planejamento Financeiro, Viabilidade Financeira ou correlatas;
  • Experiência em modelagem financeira, com domínio de conceitos de matemática financeira, contabilidade e instrumentos de dívida;
  • Domínio do Microsoft Excel (avançado, incluindo VBA) e Microsoft PowerPoint;
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e atento a detalhes.

O QUE NÃO É OBRIGATÓRIO, MAS PODE TE DESTACAR:
